data.description: Swords are melee weapons that are classified as either shortswords or broadswords: Shortswords stab towards the cursor in any direction, while broadswords are swung over the player's head and generally have a longer range. Some swords also fire projectiles when swung, giving them a long-ranged attack...

<blockquote class="quotation noexcerpt"><div class="m nomobile" style="">“</div><div class="c"><p style="margin-bottom: 0;"><span class="gameText">Sword beats paper! Get one today.</span></p><p style="float: right;">— <img alt="Emote Town Merchant.gif" src="/images/Emote_Town_Merchant.gif?f98f55" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="18" height="20" data-file-width="18" data-file-height="20"> The <a href="/wiki/Merchant" title="Merchant">Merchant</a></p></div></blockquote>
<p><b>Swords</b> are <a href="/wiki/Melee_weapons" title="Melee weapons">melee weapons</a> that are classified as either <b>shortswords</b> or <b>broadswords</b>: Shortswords stab towards the cursor in any direction, while broadswords are swung over the player's head and generally have a longer range. Some swords also fire projectiles when swung, giving them a long-ranged attack.
</p><p>Newly created <a href="/wiki/Character" title="Character">characters</a> spawn with a <a href="/wiki/Copper_Shortsword" title="Copper Shortsword">Copper Shortsword</a> (<a href="/wiki/Iron_Shortsword" title="Iron Shortsword">Iron Shortsword</a> in <a href="/wiki/Journey_Mode" title="Journey Mode">Journey Mode</a>).
</p><p>Their best <a href="/wiki/Modifier" class="mw-redirect" title="Modifier">modifier</a> is generally <b>Legendary</b>.
</p>

<h2><span class="mw-headline" id="Notes">Notes</span><span class="mw-editsection"><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</span><a href="/wiki/Swords?action=edit&section=4" title="Edit section: Notes"><span>edit</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</span></span></h2>
<ul><li><a href="/wiki/Melee_speed" class="mw-redirect" title="Melee speed">Melee speed</a> will affect the <a href="/wiki/Velocity" title="Velocity">velocity</a> of most projectiles fired by broadswords, but not their fire rate.
